workout.title: Sandman
workout.thangs:
Thang 1 - Sandman

Split PAX into equal teams (4 or 3 per)

Pax not on sandbag will rotate through:
10 curls
10 merkins
10 lunges (2 is 1)
10 rows

Buy in - team completes 100 sandbag back squats rotating bag every 10 reps. Those not on bag hold al gore.

PAX 1 will shuffle sandbag to far cone and back.
PAX 2 will clean and toss sandbag to the 3rd  cone and shuffle back
PAX 3 will bear crawl drag Sandy to the near cone and shuffle back
PAX 4 will complete 20 sandbag shoulder to shoulder.

Continue home base reps for the 6.

Round 2 - each man does a new sandbag workout. Homebase pads do same exercises.
Repeat for rounds 3 and 4.

Cash out - team completes 100 sandbag front squats rotating bag every 10 reps. Those not on bag hold al gore.

For the 6 - sit yo butt down squats - alternate the Q every 10 reps.

workout.notes:
Keeping commitments is about one thing:
Trust.
When you keep commitments to others, you build trust with them
When you keep commitments to yourself, you build trust in yourself
And if a man doesn’t trust himself… everything else starts to wobble.


“Every man here made a commitment this morning.
That alarm went off… and you had a choice.”
“You either honored it… or you negotiated with it.”


“When you keep your commitments to other people, you build trust.
People know you’ll show up. They can count on you.”
“But when you keep commitments to yourself…”
“That’s where confidence is built.”


“Because every time you say you’re gonna do something…
and you don’t…”
“You don’t just break a promise.”
“You cast a vote against the kind of man you say you are.”


“And every time you follow through…”
“You cast a vote for that man.”


“Nobody sees the commitments you break to yourself.
No one’s clapping when you hit snooze.
No one’s calling you out when you cut corners.”
“But you know.”
“And over time… that voice either gets stronger…”
“Or it gets quieter.”


“In F3 we talk about Fitness, Fellowship, and Faith.”
“You can’t build any of those on broken commitments.”
Fitness → showing up when you don’t feel like it
Fellowship → being a man others can rely on
Faith → living aligned with what you say matters


“Big things aren’t built on big moments.”
“They’re built on small commitments… kept consistently.”
“So the question isn’t ‘Can you do something great?’”
“It’s this:”
“Can you be trusted to do what you said you’d do… 


“Every kept commitment is a brick. Every broken one is a crack.”


Tying in fear, triggers and commitments
(THE THREE Q SOURCES FROM  @D20 THAT I'VE DONE)
“Fear will try to stop you.
Triggers will try to shake you.
But commitments are what define you.

Every time you follow through, you prove those things don’t control you… 
you do.”

All PAX line up on baseline. PAX 1… will sprint forward and back pedal back on outside and middle line of each tennis court until completely across court and back. PAX 2 will be doing AMRAP…

PENGUIN TAPS
RUSSIAN TWISTS
IMPERIAL SQUAT WALKERS

ENTHUSIASTIC CARLTONS

*Football will be placed at station 1 and the goal is to move the ball through the stations 2 times by throwing ball to Dad/2.0… once you catch it freeze and keep throwing until you reach next station.
*Ball travels two times around…

THANG 2: Partner Over the Net
All PAX line up on baseline. The first set of PlAX in line, line up across from each other with net in between. They will proceed to pass the ball over the net while shuffling down to other side… if ball is dropped count up merkins… sprint back to baseline when other side is reached, go to back of line for next set of pax to go…

Remaining Pax on baseline will conduct 1 exercise AMRAP until set of PAX returns, rotating through the exercises… 
1) MERKINS
2) SQUATS
3) BBSU
4) SSH

BOHICA - 2 Rounds
*Al Gore for the 6

Step 3: Execute.

Step 4: Repeat from step 1 and find a new goal.

Thing 1 - Upper Body Pyramid

Pax Line up on sideline of bball court
* 10 Thrusters - On cue
Bear Crawl drag to cones at mid court

Farmer carry (Right) to far sideline 
* 20 Merkins - On Cue
Farmer carry (Left) to midcourt
* 25 Rows
Bear crawl drag back to sideline
* 30 Curls
Bear crawl drag back to midcourt
* 25 Bench Press
Farmer carry (Right) to far sideline 
* 20 Decline Merkins
Farmer carry (Left) to midcourt
* 15 Overhead Press
Bear crawl drag to sideline
* 10 Burpees

Q-Source: Fear catches you in weird ways. Fear makes you do things you wouldn't otherwise do. Fear starts your brain rationalizing, and sometimes we're so good at rationalizing, we don't even realize we've done it.

Pax divided into 2 groups (1s and 2s)

Thing 2: Lower Body AMRAP
Rifle carry Cindy to small pavilion
1s doing step ups on benches under pavilion
2s doing 15 monkey humpers, 15 goblet squats, 15 Bobby Hurleys (and repeat that pattern AMRAP)

EMOM timer set for 2 minutes with 5 second transition period.

Every time timer goes off 1s and 2s switch stations.

Also each station will have an 80lb sandbag/med ball and 60lb sandbag. 2 Pax in each group will bearhug carry each around the loop. When looping pax get back they join original group doing AMRAP and pass sandbag off to pair of pax in group who has not done loop. Sandbags keep moving the whole time. 

Which Loop pax does depends on what station pax is at when they start with Sandbag: pavilion = south loop. Squat station = north loop

Once all pax have done 2 loops, the exercise over
workout.finisher:
Thing 3: Beep Teat Burpee Fest
Pax back to basketball court - line up on sideline. Timer is set to ring Bell every 7 seconds.

On ring, pax sprint to other side of court. Continue this every time it ring. If pax does not make it to other side before ring - pax does burpees on sideline until rest of pax are back to that sideline.
